name: Fault Tolerance & High Availability
postCreateCommand: bash -c 'wget -q -O yb-sample-apps.jar.part https://github.com/yugabyte/yb-sample-apps/releases/download/v${YB_SAMPLE_APPS_VERSION}/yb-sample-apps.jar && mv yb-sample-apps.jar.part yb-sample-apps.jar && echo "✅ FT exercise ready"'
postStartCommand: bash -c 'bash .devcontainer/scripts/start-ybdb.sh 6 && echo "" && echo "▶  Terminal → Run Task → ysql-load      (YSQL load generator)" && echo "▶  Terminal → Run Task → ycql-load      (YCQL load generator)" && echo "▶  Terminal → Run Task → ft-demo         (guided chaos demo)" && echo "▶  Terminal → Run Task → ft-ws           (Workshop shell for manual commands)" && echo "▶  Terminal → Run Task → ft: start all  (launch all three at once)"'

tasks.label: ysql-load
tasks.detail: Start YSQL SqlInserts load against the 6-node cluster (init-ft)
tasks.command: echo '⏳ Waiting for yb-sample-apps.jar and YSQL :5433 on 3 nodes...'; until [ -f yb-sample-apps.jar ] && (echo >/dev/tcp/${env:HOST_LB}/5433) 2>/dev/null && (echo >/dev/tcp/${env:HOST_LB2}/5433) 2>/dev/null && (echo >/dev/tcp/${env:HOST_LB3}/5433) 2>/dev/null; do sleep 3; done; java -jar yb-sample-apps.jar --workload SqlInserts --num_reads 15000000 --num_writes 2000000 --num_threads_read 5 --num_threads_write 2 --nodes ${env:HOST_LB}:5433,${env:HOST_LB2}:5433,${env:HOST_LB3}:5433 --password ${env:SECRET} --username ${env:YB_USER}

tasks.label: ycql-load
tasks.detail: Start YCQL CassandraKeyValue load against the 6-node cluster (init-ft)
tasks.command: echo '⏳ Waiting for yb-sample-apps.jar and YCQL :9042 on 3 nodes...'; until [ -f yb-sample-apps.jar ] && (echo >/dev/tcp/${env:HOST_LB}/9042) 2>/dev/null && (echo >/dev/tcp/${env:HOST_LB2}/9042) 2>/dev/null && (echo >/dev/tcp/${env:HOST_LB3}/9042) 2>/dev/null; do sleep 3; done; java -jar yb-sample-apps.jar --workload CassandraKeyValue --num_reads 15000000 --num_writes 2000000 --num_threads_read 5 --num_threads_write 2 --nodes ${env:HOST_LB}:9042,${env:HOST_LB2}:9042,${env:HOST_LB3}:9042 --password ${env:SECRET} --username ${env:YB_USER}

tasks.label: ft-demo
tasks.command: cd init-ft && echo '🔥 ft-demo  —  Fault Tolerance demo' && echo '   Run when ready: bash prompt.sh' && exec bash

raw.label: ft: start all
raw.detail: Launch ysql-load, ycql-load and ft-demo together (init-ft)

tasks.label: ft-ws
tasks.detail: Workshop shell for manual Fault Tolerance commands — ysqlsh, yb-admin (init-ft)
tasks.command: cd init-ft && echo '🔥 ft-ws  —  Workshop shell' && echo '   Run manual ysqlsh and yb-admin commands here' && exec bash
